name: Jev
description: Answers typed Choice, Score, and yes/no (Noul) questions about your app state with calibrated probabilities and confidence, for developers building structured AI decisions.

skills.name: Choice Questions
skills.description: Selects one option from a set you define and returns the chosen option, a probability for each option, and a confidence score.

skills.name: Score Questions
skills.description: Rates content against ordered, descriptive levels and returns a score, a probability for each level, and a confidence score.

skills.name: Noul Yes/No Questions
skills.description: Evaluates a yes/no question against the supplied state and returns the probability that the answer is yes, with optional criteria.

skills.name: Batched Question Fan-Out
skills.description: Sends many named questions against one state in a single POST /v1/systemone call and returns each typed answer under its key.
